notes.title: Dungeon Manager ZV: Resurrection Update
notes.content:
Hello all,
Dungeon Manager ZV: Resurrection's update is here. 

Version 1.2 includes
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
-Strengthened AI Heroes
-Upgraded the code base so the game now supports a greater range of PC specs 
-Fixed bug related to the display system
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
Have a fun with the new version.

Thanks,
